_comment: Style guides appended to your prompt with --style NAME[,NAME2]. Each adds 'prompt' to the positive and 'negative' to the negative prompt. SDXL honors (term:weight) emphasis. Written for ANSI: the recurring theme is FLAT regions and HARD edges, because that is what survives 80 columns and 16 colors. Add your own entries here.

blocktronics.prompt: modern blockart, (heavy block shading:1.3), bold geometric forms, dense detail, dramatic lighting, high contrast

oldskool.prompt: early 1990s BBS ANSI art, (chunky blocks:1.2), simple bold shapes, limited shading, naive charm

bbs.prompt: BBS login screen, centered emblem, decorative border, banner layout, symmetrical composition

fileid.prompt: small compact logo, tight composition, thick letterforms, minimal detail

logo.prompt: (bold display lettering:1.4), thick blocky letterforms, strong outline, graphic logotype, poster layout
logo.negative: thin strokes, script, handwriting, serif, fine typography

highcontrast.prompt: (extreme contrast:1.4), pure black shadows, blown highlights, hard-edged shapes, poster reduction
highcontrast.negative: gradient, soft shading, midtones, haze, fog

flat.prompt: (flat color regions:1.3), cel shaded, hard color boundaries, no gradients, vector poster
flat.negative: gradient, airbrush, soft shading, blur, glow

silhouette.prompt: strong readable silhouette, single subject, clean shape against empty background

duotone.prompt: two-color composition, stark limited palette, heavy negative space

cyberpunk.prompt: cyberpunk, neon signage, dark city, magenta and cyan glow, hard rim light

fantasy.prompt: dark fantasy, heraldic, ornate, dramatic, gothic

horror.prompt: horror, creepy, grotesque, menacing, deep shadow

demoscene.prompt: demoscene aesthetic, chrome lettering, starfield, geometric abstraction, retro-futuristic

skull.prompt: skull motif, bone, gothic emblem, symmetrical, menacing

portrait.prompt: head and shoulders bust, front view, strong directional light, simple background

landscape.prompt: wide scene, bold horizon, layered silhouettes, dramatic sky

emblem.prompt: centered emblem, badge, crest, radial symmetry, decorative frame
